title: MarsOrtho I2I
subtitle: HiRISE → Mastcam-Z paired image-to-image translation dataset
description:
Paired HiRISE (orbital, 1ch) and Mastcam-Z (ground-projected, 3ch) patches for cross-perspective texture translation on Mars.

- Train: 384 patches
- Test: 60 patches
- Patch size: 256x256 (both)
- Coverage: Jezero Crater
